stem: Two weeks into a 12-week season, a new pair of earbuds has a sell-through of 100%: every unit received has sold and none has come back. What is the most likely issue?

options.text: The earbuds need a markdown to clear the rest of the stock
The earbuds were priced too high, so the rivals will win the sales
Returns were left out of the count, so the rate is overstated now
Voltmarkt bought too few units and may lose sales until more arrive
